1.Title: Double Espresso
1.Description:
When Severian uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the accumulated <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> increases to 50.
When Severian switches in through <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Clear Out</color>, the skill is replaced with a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. The entry type is not changed, and it is treated as a non-heavy attack. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
Each time Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>.
When Severian's attacks hit a target, they ignore 15% of the target's Wind RES.
1.Lore:
Bitterness, perhaps, is the necessary cost of always staying alert.
That bitter taste, sinking from the root of the tongue into the heart, provides just enough of a jolt to force you to look straight at what lurks in the shadows.
It isn't enjoyable, but someone has to do it.
"Looks bitter? I need the effect, not the taste."

2.Title: Reins of Reason
2.Description:
When Severian enters the battlefield, he recovers 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Severian triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, his PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 25s.
2.Lore:
"I've long since outgrown getting swept up in my own emotions. Excess sentiment only becomes an obstacle."
Cases, casualties, rewards and penalties, promotions and demotions, struggles and battles... Once the dust settles, the cycle begins again.
Every step demands careful consideration. Sometimes that may mean being calculating, but either way, unnecessary personal feelings have to be kept on a tight leash.
Only by becoming unyielding as iron can you force even a hairline crack into that immovable wall.

3.Title: The Last Light
3.Lore:
No matter how late you leave the Public Security precinct, there's always a light still on in his office.
There are, of course, those who resent it. The sight of him working beneath that light seems to be a kind of pressure in itself.
But whenever things descend into a darkness with no clear way forward, everyone knows where to find that last remaining light.
"Don't read too much into it. I'm just working at my own pace."

4.Title: Between Light and Shadow
4.Description:
When Severian enters combat or switches on-field, his ATK increases by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, his Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10% for 15s.
4.Lore:
"Full of himself. No sense of decorum."
"I heard there's nothing he won't do if it means racking up merits. He's completely focused on building up his own inner circle..."
"Shh. He's coming."
He walks through the silent corridor, sunlight from the window illuminating half his face and setting his silver hair aglow.

5.Title: A Heart Above 0°C
5.Lore:
How do you show that you care? By waving a speech in your hand on the campaign stage, writing letter after letter, remembering every different anniversary and special date?
Or by silently shielding someone from the wind and rain, standing behind them and always being ready to lend a hand...?
Or perhaps, just sincerely wishing for everyone to live in a better world.
"I missed two calls from home... Should I call back?"

6.Title: Beneath a Little Star
6.Description:
Severian's max <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> increases to 180, and the Flow gained when entering the battlefield increases to 180.
The additional DMG Multiplier of the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color> is increased by a fixed 350%.
Upon using the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, Severian gains <color=#FFFFFF>Windrise</color>: Accumulates 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> per second for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
6.Lore:
Flowers and victory are good things, but monuments are less so.
Medals and hope are good things, but farewells are less so.
The clamor of fame and fortune by day is bad enough, and the nights spent alone are worse. Some things simply aren't that easy to forget.
"Keep moving forward. It's the only solution."

MathSkill.Title: Additional Ability: Optimal Setup
MathSkill.Description:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character, or shares the same faction:
For every 1% CRIT Rate Severian has, his ATK increases by 8.5. This effect is capped at 100% CRIT Rate.

1000041.Title: Flow
1000041.Description:
When Severian hits enemies with specific skills or triggers a Perfect Dodge, he gains <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is capped at 150.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> reaches 100, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> and use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>.

1000042.Title: Shadowflash
1000042.Description:
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> and is not Invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill attack from an enemy and fails to actively dodge or parry the attack, Severian consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> to automatically dodge the attack and use <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> can stack up to 2 times. If Severian gains <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> while possessing max stacks, he gains 1 stack of <Term:1000043></Term> instead, and his next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swift Edge</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.

1000043.Title: Windborne
1000043.Description: Each time Severian triggers a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>. When Severian has <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>, switching to Severian or having Severian enter via a Quick Assist consumes this effect and automatically uses his <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.

163100001.Title: Basic Attack: Swift Edge
163100001.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
When the 4th attack hits an enemy, it accumulates 20 <Term:1000041></Term>.
The 4th attack can dodge enemy attacks upon the moment of activation. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, this Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to those of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>, and an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is accumulated.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
When Severian uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Spontaneity</color> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo, it does not interrupt the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo count.

163100002.Title: Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind
163100002.Description:
Automatically activates when Severian is attacked at the moment he launches the first three attacks of his Basic Attack, or when he has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> and is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack while not invulnerable:
Dashes forward, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to enemies in an area ahead.
Upon activating this skill, accumulates 15 <Term:1000041></Term>. Upon hitting an enemy, an additional 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is accumulated.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while activating this skill to quickly launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>. When the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color> is unleashed, it accumulates 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100003.Title: Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt
163100003.Description:
With enough <Term:1000041></Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> and activate:
Dodges backward and charges up, then continuously darts around the field while unleashing slashes, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to enemies in an area in front.
The backward dodge can dodge enemy attacks. Successfully dodging an enemy attack triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> and accumulates 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100021.Description: 4th Attack Successful Perfect Dodge DMG Multiplier

163100026.Description: 4th Attack Successful Perfect Dodge Daze Multiplier

163100004.Title: Special Attack: Gale Rend
163100004.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes slashes and stabs forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

163100005.Title: EX Special Attack: Swiftwind Rupture
163100005.Description:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a combination of slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire forward, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> and gaining 1 stack of <Term:1000042></Term>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to continuously consume Energy before the cannon attack, and repeatedly launch wind blades that deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to enemies.
When reaching the maximum amount of Energy consumed, gains an additional stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100006.Title: Dodge: Windshift
163100006.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Windshift</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it accumulates 15 <Term:1000041></Term>. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100007.Title: Dash Attack: Sheer Assault
163100007.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches an attack forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

163100008.Title: Dodge Counter: Fatal End
163100008.Description:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Windshift</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a quick slash forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
If switched off-field immediately after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Windshift</color>, this skill is activated automatically.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100009.Title: Dodge: Spontaneity
163100009.Description:
After dodging backward, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Provokes the enemy.

163100010.Title: Chain Attack: Coldblade Reap
163100010.Description:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulates 35 <Term:1000041></Term>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100011.Title: Ultimate: Annihilating Windstorm
163100011.Description:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes multiple rapid slashes in succession, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulates 100 <Term:1000041></Term>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100012.Title: Quick Assist: Field Orders
163100012.Description:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dashes forward quickly, unleashing claw strikes and slashes at enemies ahead to deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100013.Title: Defensive Assist: Provocation Prohibited
163100013.Description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100014.Title: Assist Follow-Up: Fight Force with Force
163100014.Description:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire against enemies in sequence, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

163100015.Title: Entry Skill: Clear Out
163100015.Description:
When Severian has <Term:1000043></Term> and is in combat, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch him into battle and activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Activating this skill is considered activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
